{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Check how many rows have sentinel values
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Filter out rows with sentinel values before computing the mean for SEVERE patients
severe_df_clean = df[(df['severity'] == 'severe') & (df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients (excluding sentinel values)
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

sentinel_count, mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
